notes.title: The Islander: Town Architect is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31851079/ea69fd3ebeec2e4743e9c46d32e80e2a3183144c.png[/img]

Hello islanders,

We just wanted to let you know that our new game and sequel to The Islander - [b]The Islander: Town Architect is finally released on Steam[/b], so  head to calm & exotic Polynesia to become a grand-master town architect.  To celebrate this occasion the game is 10% off.

You can get it here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1042160/

[h1]FEATURES[/h1]
[b]Design house exterior[/b] - choose the building type, elect the wanted roof and walls design, make sure windows and doors fits the overall look of the house, or go wild and create craziest designs.

[b]Don't limit yourself to house designing only, landscape your town[/b], after all you are TOWN ARCHITECT. Build pathways and fences, plant trees and shrubs, erect statues and fountains.

[b]Expand and urbanize your island[/b] by building stores, agricultural and public buildings, like - libraries, tower bells and observatories.

[b]Sizable catalog of items and decorations[/b] ranging from flowers and bushes to lighthouses and pyramids.

[b]Relaxing atmosphere[/b] to ease your stressed-out mind.

notes.title: NEW THE ISLANDER GAME
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1042160/The_Islander_Landscape_Designer/

We are back with new building experience - The Islander: Landscape Designer.

Escape your stressful and mundane everyday routine and head to exotic Polynesia to become a grand-master landscape designer. Turn this sandy wilderness into a beautiful paradise.

Its bigger, it's better, it's more fun.

notes.title: Morning Never Comes - New Game
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31851079/d93792440901834691edc838cd9139ba694e7a2f.png[/img]

Hello everybody,

We recently released a new bite sized score attack game called Morning Never Comes.

Morning Never Comes is arcade style arena twin stick shooter that takes place in the dark and eerie kids bedroom filled with evil toys trying to kill you. Collect synergetic power-ups and survive as long as possible.

This game is designed to be played in short bursts, just to kill some time. Morning Never Comes is a score attack game so your main objective is to beat your best score. It also has integrated Steam Leaderboard so You'll be competing with your friends and the rest of the world.

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/829260/Morning_Never_Comes/]http://store.steampowered.com/app/829260/Morning_Never_Comes/[/url]
